name: delivery-route-measure
description: DELIVERY-ROUTE-OVERRIDE (v0.31.9.0): the Accessibility panel's Delivery route section lets the user replace the published SG typicals with their block's real lift/door figures. Shot in Pro, which is the only mode where it is reachable — the HOST panel's `accessibility` flag is pro-tier too, so Simple cannot open the panel at all and the Simple case is covered by DeliveryRouteFields.test.tsx instead of a screenshot that would only prove the panel is shut.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: panel-visible
steps.failMessage: Accessibility panel did not mount. It is lazy-loaded behind Suspense and the chunk fetch competes with the scene build, which took 14.6s and >22.7s across two runs — hence 60s, matching the transition guards raised in v0.31.8.94.

steps.name: route-section-appears
steps.failMessage: Delivery route section missing in Pro — deliveryRouteMeasure defaults on at pro tier

steps.failMessage: the section is at the BOTTOM of a long panel, so a screenshot without scrolling proves nothing
